name: Yuen Sheung Ying
source:
"But no matter your reasons... there can be no excuse for abandoning your loyalty to the Society."

Conjoined twins, fated from birth to become half-machine. Just and honourable, the Yuen brothers are renowned in the Qingyun Society as the "Twin Yuen Heroes." A Waijia master, Sheung Ying wields guai sticks.
